title: Text: DET Tim Grieve ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Tim, good luck in draft. Hope you and the family are well.
Appreciate it!  All good down here in Texas but would much rather be in Lakeland with the group!
I can imagine. Sick of sitting home myself...feels so weird
It's been a looooong spring.  I'm not sure my family likes me as much as they used to.  😂
